_comment: Meshy prompts (docs/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md). Characters are the lane drama's main cast by the owner's decision (COPYRIGHT_REGISTER C-201); keys are the unit/enemy ids they play. Never name the series or an actor, never ask for a real person's likeness: describe period costume and props only. 'style'/'texture_style' are prepended to character prompts, 'prop_style' to props.
style: Chibi-proportioned stylized cartoon game character (oversized head about one third of total height, short sturdy body, big hands and feet), like a collectible vinyl toy for a mobile tower-defense game, clean simple shapes, bold readable silhouette, full body standing in T-pose, facing the camera, no base, no background.
creature_style: Stylized cartoon game model for a mobile tower-defense game, chunky toy-like proportions, like a collectible vinyl toy, clean simple shapes, bold readable silhouette, one single subject only (no extra characters), full body seen from a three-quarter front view, no base, no background.
texture_style: Hand-painted flat colors, soft shading, no photorealism, warm Mediterranean palette, clean cloth folds, friendly expressive face.
enemy_texture_style: Hand-painted flat colors, soft shading, no photorealism, colder palette of indigo, basalt grey and olive with red accents, clean cloth folds, hostile scowling expressive face, menacing but never grotesque, no caricature.

animations._comment: Meshy library action ids, filled after running `python tools/meshy/meshy.py library`. One clip per file so Roblox imports each as its own track. Defenders need idle + attack; the auto-rig already returns a free walk clip for attackers.
